# foldcrumbs

> Persistent cross-session memory for coding agents: a folder of typed markdown files,
> no server, no database, no external service, no account. Lexical recall works fully
> offline; optional semantic channel (bundled local ONNX model or any OpenAI-compatible
> `/v1/embeddings` endpoint) is opt-in and never required. The files are the product —
> grep, edit, and version them with your own tools. Python stdlib core (pip install
> foldcrumbs), MIT.

This index is for LLM agents and AI-assisted search. Human docs start at the README
(English; Italiano: README.it.md, 中文: README.zh.md). Links are raw files in this
repository (branch `main`).

## Start here (agent-oriented)

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vcnngr/foldcrumbs/main/AGENTS.md):
  What an agent must get right — store location, the recall/fetch/timeline retrieval
  loop, visibility rules (archived/superseded/expired/contested/authorizations),
  memory-writing conventions, federation etiquette. The single most important file.
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vcnngr/foldcrumbs/main/README.md):
  Full documentation: install (incl. Claude Code hooks), env configuration, optional
  semantic recall, bundled local model, dashboard, graph layer, CLI reference,
  federation, adopt/outcome fleet learning, MCP server.
- [Quick start (README §Quick start)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vcnngr/foldcrumbs/main/README.md):
  `pip install foldcrumbs`, `foldcrumbs install`, then remember/recall/status.

## Integrations

- [docs/paperclip.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vcnngr/foldcrumbs/main/docs/paperclip.md):
  Paperclip memory-provider bridge — JSON ops (capabilities/ingest/query/get/browse/
  forget/usage), scope mapping (company/agent/project), exit-code contract.
- [paperclip-plugin-foldcrumbs](https://github.com/vcnngr/paperclip-plugin-foldcrumbs):
  Installable Paperclip plugin (separate repo): recall/remember agent tools,
  run-outcome auto-ingest, managed skill, multi-company safe.
- [MCP server (README §MCP server)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vcnngr/foldcrumbs/main/README.md):
  stdio MCP with recall/remember/fetch/timeline/adopt tools.

## Quality evidence

- [benchmarks/quality/RESULTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vcnngr/foldcrumbs/main/benchmarks/quality/RESULTS.md):
  Measured numbers with declared limits: golden set 40/40 both channels; paraphrase
  lexical 7/10 → bundled-semantic 10/10 (FP 0/0); hard-negative frontier lexical 7/7,
  semantic 6/7 (n=7, directional). Reproduction scripts included.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vcnngr/foldcrumbs/main/CHANGELOG.md):
  Version history with what shipped and why.

## Design notes (deep dives)

- [docs/design/local-semantic-0.12.0.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vcnngr/foldcrumbs/main/docs/design/local-semantic-0.12.0.md):
  Local semantic channel design — loopback-only discovery, channel-first fallback chain,
  explicit endpoint always wins.
- [docs/design/graph-layer.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vcnngr/foldcrumbs/main/docs/design/graph-layer.md):
  Relation graph: explicit predicates vs model-proposed edges, traversal ≠ authority.
- [docs/design/fleet-learning.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vcnngr/foldcrumbs/main/docs/design/fleet-learning.md):
  adopt/outcome: learning across instances without a central service.

## Non-goals (honest boundaries)

No cloud sync service, no vector DB dependency, no daemon. Semantic recall is optional
and degrades to lexical. Deletion is soft by default; auto-prune never deletes on text
matches. Provenance records claims, not verified identities.
